warnings: template_only: no observations have been collected
rollup_rule: API observations (closed_model, retrieval) and consumer_surface observations are never combined into a silent rollup. Aided, unaided, and control observations never share a denominator.

observation_template.exact_prompt: Verbatim UTF-8 prompt string sent to the surface, byte-identical to prompt_universe.json
observation_template.model: exact model ID and version string as exposed by the provider
observation_template.response_text: raw response stored separately; never truncated before hashing

hashing_note: All *_hash fields are null on this provisional template because no hashing runtime was available. Real SHA-256 values are required before any wave is treated as frozen evidence. Never write a placeholder digest.
validity_rules: A refusal, provider error, truncation, or off-topic answer is invalid and is excluded from numerators and denominators but retained in the raw record.
Invalid-rate is reported per lane and surface for every wave.
